comment: Generated by sh products/catalyst/bootstrap/api/internal/capability/write.sh from platform/_capabilities/*.yaml and every blueprint.yaml. Do not edit.

keys.name: provider
keys.description: Name of the implementation Blueprint, for example bp-object-bucket.

keys.name: endpoint
keys.description: URL of the S3 endpoint, https://host[:port], reachable from every region the consumer runs in. http://host[:port] only for a service name of the cluster (*.svc, *.svc.cluster.local), whose traffic never leaves the cluster network.

keys.name: region
keys.description: Region string the client must send; us-east-1 when the implementation has none.

keys.name: access-key-id
keys.description: Access key scoped to this bucket only.

keys.name: secret-access-key
keys.description: Secret key of that access key.

keys.name: ca.crt
keys.description: PEM bundle; present and not empty when the endpoint certificate is not publicly trusted.

contextFields.name: versioning
contextFields.description: true = the bucket keeps every version of an object.

contextFields.name: retentionDays
contextFields.description: Days after which objects expire; 0 = objects never expire.
